description: IDS event data payload. Contains the encrypted structured extraction result plus grouped IDS processing metadata aligned with the AIDataStructure process-document response. Scalar projections needed for event filtering, routing, and search are exposed at the SAFIDSEventType root.

payload.description: Base64 representation of gzip-compressed and encrypted structured output from document processing. This is the encrypted SAF event equivalent of the OAS DocumentExtractionResponse.result value.

payloadSignature.description: Digital signature for integrity verification of encrypted payload. Created by signing payload using ECDSA with secp384r1 curve and SHA-384 hash. Encoded in ASN.1 format and transmitted as Base64.

encryptionKey.description: Encrypted AES symmetric key used to decrypt the payload. Key was encrypted with eventReceiver's public key using RSA with OAEP padding and SHA-256 hash. Transmitted as Base64.

publicKeyVersion.description: Version identifier of the recipient's public key used to encrypt the encryptionKey. Determines which private key can decrypt the key.

signatureKeyVersion.description: Version identifier of the sender's signature key used to sign the payload. Determines which public key can verify the signature.

idsbasicProcessingMetadata.description: Model, processing mode, timing and aggregate confidence score. Source of root projections idsconfidenceScore.

idsdocumentQualityMetrics.description: Source document properties, OCR quality, AGB handling, completeness, and document hash. Source of root projection idsdocumentQuality.

idsdetailedExtractionData.description: Preprocessing pipeline, preprocessing impact, field extraction details, and field transformations.

idsdocumentQualityAssessment.description: Quality-factor breakdown and recommended review strategy.

idsvalidationResults.description: Validation result, routing decision, human-review flag, and business-rule results. Source of root projections idsisValid, idsroutingDecision, idsrequiresHumanReview, and idsreviewReason.
